acts.quote: Assisted by that most disloyal traitor / The Thane of Cawdor
with his former title greet Macbeth
Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none
the Thane of Cawdor lives, / A prosperous gentleman
He bade me, from him, call thee Thane of Cawdor
why do I yield to that suggestion / Whose horrid image doth unfix my hair
oftentimes, to win us to our harm, / The instruments of darkness tell us truths
Yet do I fear thy nature; / It is too full o' the milk of human kindness

artifacts.name: Macbeth's letter
text: They met me in the day of success

waivers.reason: 학계에서 논쟁 중이다. 1.2에서 맥베스는 코더가 도운 노르웨이군과 싸웠다. 그런데도 1.3에서 그가 살아 있고 번창한다고 말한다. 앵거스는 코더의 반역이 '숨은 도움'이었다고 해명한다.
